title: Opt-in task execution and lifecycle contracts
outcomes: Validate explicit task execution, dependency and phase contracts before mutation while preserving legacy tasks.

in: Versioned task/project/brief contracts and dependency claim gates
out: Model dispatch, task worktrees and release execution; follow-up ABC tasks own these
boundaries: Task intake, persisted .go state and dependency participant repositories

decision_rights: Authorize execution and choose model; GO on 2026-09-13
Implement bounded contract choices and document compatibility behavior

constraints: Opt-in: historical done and unconfigured legacy tasks remain unchanged.
Product tasks require release profiles; mechanical/no-change outcomes require an explicit reason under a non-release profile; source smoke fixtures remain reusable.
Do not treat model selection metadata as proof of dispatch.
Missing participant, cyclic dependency or absent required completion evidence fails closed.

quality_attributes.scenario: Invalid execution profile or dependency supplied at intake
quality_attributes.measure: Task or hierarchy writes before rejection

quality_attributes.scenario: Existing valid tasks without execution contracts
Unfulfilled, missing or cyclic dependency at next/claim

risks: Cross-repository availability may block readiness; return actionable blockers instead of guessing a sibling.
